newsitem.title: USA: Guarantee Life Q1 net up on growth plan.
newsitem.headline: Guarantee Life Q1 net up on growth plan.

text.p: Guarantee Life Cos Inc said Friday sales momentum stemming from its growth strategies helped earnings rise in the first quarter ended March 31.

The insurance holding company reported net income of $3.2 million, or $0.32 a share, versus $2.2 million, or $0.22, in the same period last year. Revenues climbed to $79.5 million from $71.3 million in the corresponding quarter a year ago.

Guarantee Life said revenues in the latesd period were adversely affected by $3.1 million because of a previously announced decision to stop selling a fully insured small group major medical product through the Special Markets Division.
The company's shares were off 1-5/8 Friday at 18-5/8.
